text: Two identical springs of spring constant \(k\) are attached to a block of mass \(m\) and to fixed supports as shown in Fig. 13.14. Show that when the mass is displaced from its equilibrium position on either side, it executes a simple harmonic motion. Find the period of oscillations.
context: In Fig. 13.14 the block of mass \(m\) rests on a horizontal surface between two fixed vertical supports, with one spring of spring constant \(k\) joining it to the support on its left and an identical spring joining it to the support on its right.
